name: devmate
description: A VS Code assistant prototype for compact AI-supported project guidance.

devMate.backendUrl.description: Base URL of the local DevMate backend service.

devMate.maxTokens.description: Maximum response tokens shared by model reasoning, answers, and complete Code-mode file contents.

devMate.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: How long DevMate allows each model-provider call to run. The extension automatically adds a 30-second transport buffer.

devMate.commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum runtime for each approved DevMate verification command.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test tests/agentTools.test.js tests/apiClient.test.js tests/commandTools.test.js tests/context.test.js tests/conversation.test.js tests/fileChanges.test.js tests/fileTools.test.js tests/llmProfiles.test.js tests/permissions.test.js tests/projectContext.test.js tests/projectIndex.test.js tests/retryPolicy.test.js tests/webviewScript.test.js
